population: All 50 frozen original_A_portfolio_path_candidates; no new signal search
entry: LEGACY_BAR_PROXY: next contiguous 5m bar open at original signal close; no strict quote claim
quantity: One reference unit for all policy pairs; not an account-sized position or portfolio return
risk: Frozen original signal unit_net_risk; do not recompute from hindsight
exit: Existing exit_on_bar/structural_exit primitives; ORIGINAL mode invalidation and timeout; RANGE unchanged
availability: Historical assumed-close only; exit bar close is conservative label availability
missing_path: Censored with null result; no zero-return imputation
terminal: Explicit terminal liquidation, not ordinary strategy success
capital_competition: Not simulated in paired unit outcomes; use preserved full portfolio runs separately
counterfactual: Every row is hypothetical unit-policy outcome; link but never replace original 27 filled or 23 unfilled labels
validation: Require all 27 ORIGINAL realized outcomes to match existing netR/time/reason before interpreting unfilled outcomes
